evidence.reason: Line 290 short-circuits the newline-credential check whenever the authority matches the host-port regex. A split credential such as `https://alice:123456\n@host.test/` produces authority `alice:123456`, which matches `hostPort`; because `!hostPort` is false, `incomplete` is false and the credential half is emitted instead of dropped. This contradicts the function's explicit newline-split redaction intent in the no-scheme branch and can persist credentials. The host-port exception should apply only to ordinary host-port values, not when `newlineCredential` indicates a credential continuation.
